size_mb.description: Target rootfs ext4 size in MiB, max 16384 (default 1024)

token.description: Full pds_ API token — shown only once

Volume.description: A persistent volume: a per-workspace ext4 image on one agent host, attachable to sandboxes at create time

size_mb.description: Size in MiB; default 256, hard max 65536

hint.description: Suggested remediation (retry; scheduler will pick another host)

disk_rd_bytes.description: Bytes read from disk in the bucket.

disk_wr_bytes.description: Bytes written to disk in the bucket.

info.description: REST API for PandaStack — Firecracker microVM sandboxes and managed Postgres. Authenticate with a pds_ bearer token from the dashboard's API Tokens page.

post.description: Catch-all proxy to the database's in-VM query broker (port 5544). ALL HTTP methods are forwarded, and the bare /v1/databases/{id}/proxy root also routes here. This path BYPASSES the unified API auth: the credential is the per-database broker_token (Bearer pds_pg_…) returned by GET /v1/databases/{id}, enforced by the in-VM broker itself. The primary broker endpoint is POST {proxy}/v1/query. Auto-wakes a suspended database on connect.

schema.description: Broker request body (e.g. {"query": "SELECT ...", "params": [...]} for v1/query); validated by the in-VM broker.

200.description: Rotation complete. Normally a full DatabaseInfo with the fresh credentials; if the credential read-back raced, a fallback {id, status: "rotated", detail} object — fetch the new values via GET /v1/databases/{id}. Any error status means the rotation did not complete and retrying is safe.
